name: application-dating-profile-card
title: Dating Profile Card
description: Full-bleed photo profile card with a bottom gradient scrim carrying name/age/bio/interests, plus Pass/Like actions below the card.
useWhen: Presenting a single dating/social profile as a full-bleed photo card with an accept/reject decision to make.
Bio and interest tags should overlay the photo directly rather than sit in a separate white card body below a thumbnail.
You want Pass/Like actions rendered as their own row beneath the card rather than floating inside it.
avoidWhen: You need the layered peek-behind-cards stack effect for browsing a queue of items generically — use `card-stack` for that stacked-cards composition instead.
The profile has no photo, or the photo shouldn't be the dominant visual element — use a plain contact/profile card instead.
You need actual swipe-gesture dragging rather than tap-to-decide buttons — this card shows the decision UI, not gesture physics.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-size card (h-[26rem] w-72) with the scrim and text scaling with the card; interest tags wrap onto additional lines rather than overflowing.
accessibility: Pass/Like buttons have descriptive aria-labels naming the specific profile, not generic 'Reject'/'Accept' labels.
Text over the photo sits inside a sufficiently opaque gradient scrim to maintain contrast regardless of the underlying photo content.
All profile facts (name, age, occupation, distance, bio, interests) are real text content, remaining fully readable to screen readers despite the photo-first visual design.
